title: Attention
description: One measured span of a person's attention on a run (PRD 14.2, FR-MTR-05): steering (intake, a question, a card, a take-over) or review (a deliverable open before approval). apps/web measures it, as do the channel handlers for WhatsApp and email answers; tilo-api writes it, and packages/metering subtracts the minutes from time saved. Event timestamps cannot give this, because the gap between a question and its answer is waiting time, not attention. A span holds ids and times only, never content (PRD 16.5). Rules MT-07 and MT-08 in contracts/metering.rules.md.

ref.description: What the attention was spent on: a card id (ULID) for a question or card span, the artifact open for review (art_ id) for a review span, and null for intake or a take-over with no card (BQ-65).
